info.name: Diamond Market API
info.description:
Complete API reference for the Diamond Management and Listing System.

Setup:
1. Set `base_url` variable (default: http://localhost:4000)
2. Run Admin Login -> copy token -> set `admin_token` variable
3. Run Owner Login -> copy token -> set `owner_token` variable

request.description:
Verify the API is running.

Response 200:
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "Diamond Market API is running", "timestamp": "..." }
```

Super Admin login. Token auto-saved to `admin_token` on success.

Request body:
- email (string, required)
- password (string, required)

Response 200:
```json
{ "success": true, "data": { "token": "...", "user": { "id": "...", "role": "SUPER_ADMIN" } } }
```

Errors:
- 400: Validation failed
- 401: Invalid credentials

Business Owner login. Token + businessId auto-saved on success.

Request body:
- businessSlug (string, required)
- email (string, required)
- password (string, required)

Response 200:
```json
{ "success": true, "data": { "token": "...", "user": { "id": "...", "role": "OWNER", "businessId": "..." } } }
```

Errors:
- 400: Validation failed
- 401: Invalid credentials
- 404: Business not found

Logout (client-side token disposal).

Response 200:
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "Logged out successfully", "data": null }
```

Errors:
- 401: No or invalid token

List all registered businesses.

Auth: Super Admin only

Response 200:
```json
{ "success": true, "data": [ { "id": "...", "name": "...", "slug": "...", "_count": { "diamonds": 42 } } ] }
```

Errors:
- 401: No or invalid token
- 403: Not Super Admin

Create a new business + auto-creates owner login account.

Auth: Super Admin
Content-Type: multipart/form-data

Required fields: name, contactNumber, ownerName, email, whatsappNumber, ownerPassword
Optional fields: font, logo (file)

Response 201:
```json
{ "success": true, "data": { "id": "...", "slug": "abc-diamonds", ... } }
```

Errors:
- 400: Validation failed
- 401 / 403: Auth
- 409: Email or slug already exists

Get single business with diamond and inquiry counts.

Errors: 401 | 403 | 404

Update business fields (all optional). Send `logo` file to update logo.

Errors: 400 | 401 | 403 | 404

Delete business and all its diamonds, inquiries, and user accounts.

WARNING: This is irreversible.

Errors: 401 | 403 | 404

Set visual theme for a business storefront. All fields optional.

Errors: 400 | 401 | 403 | 404

Create an additional owner login for a business.

Errors: 400 | 401 | 403 | 404 | 409 (email already taken)

Fetch theme and branding for a business by slug. No auth required.

Response 200:
```json
{ "success": true, "data": { "name": "...", "logoUrl": "...", "font": "Poppins", "theme": { ... }, "whatsappNumber": "+91..." } }
```

Errors: 404 - Business not found

Paginated diamonds for a frontend storefront. No auth required.

Filters match the `GET /api/diamonds` endpoint (supports `shade`, `tableMin`, `colors`, etc).

Response 200:
```json
{ "success": true, "data": { "diamonds": [...], "total":... } }
```

List diamonds with advanced filters and pagination. No auth required.

businessId is REQUIRED.

All filter params are optional. Range filters (min/max), comma-separated exact matches, and string search are supported.

Response 200:
```json
{ "success": true, "data": { "diamonds": [...], "total": 120, "page": 1, "limit": 20, "totalPages": 6 } }
```

Get full diamond detail. No auth required.

Errors: 404 - Diamond not found

Add a diamond to the inventory.

Auth: Owner or Super Admin
Content-Type: multipart/form-data

Required: businessId, shape, carat, color, clarity, price, uploadMethod
uploadMethod values: MANUAL | CERTIFICATE_ID | CERTIFICATE_FILE
certificateLab values: GIA | IGI | HRD | AGS | OTHER

File fields (optional): images[] (up to 10), video (1), certificateFile (PDF or image)

Response 201:
```json
{ "success": true, "data": { "id": "...", ... } }
```

Errors: 400 | 401 | 403

Update any diamond fields (all optional). Owners can only update their own business diamonds.

Errors: 400 | 401 | 403 | 404

Delete a diamond and its inquiries. Owners can only delete diamonds in their own business.

Response 200:
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "Diamond deleted", "data": null }
```

Errors: 401 | 403 | 404

Fetch diamond specs from GIA or IGI by certificate number.

Auth: Owner or Super Admin

lab values: GIA | IGI

Response 200:
```json
{ "success": true, "data": { "certificateNumber": "...", "shape": "Round Brilliant", "carat": 1.02, "color": "E", "clarity": "VS1", "cut": "Excellent", ... } }
```

Errors: 400 | 401 | 403 | 422 - GIA/IGI fetch failed

Upload a certificate file (PDF or image) and extract data using Tesseract.js OCR.

Auth: Owner or Super Admin
Content-Type: multipart/form-data

Response 200:
```json
{ "success": true, "data": { "certificateNumber": "...", "shape": "...", "carat": "1.02", "color": "E", "clarity": "VS1", "confidence": 0.87 } }
```

confidence is 0 to 1 (Tesseract accuracy score).

Errors: 400 - No file | 401 | 403

request.description:
Submit a client inquiry. No auth required.

diamondId is optional. Omit for a general business inquiry.
Side effects: sends email notification to business owner (if SMTP configured).

Response 201:
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "Inquiry submitted successfully", "data": { "id": "..." } }
```

Errors:
- 400: Validation failed
- 404: Business not found

List inquiries.

Auth: Owner or Super Admin
- Owners automatically see only their own business inquiries
- Super Admin can filter by businessId or diamondId

Response 200:
```json
{ "success": true, "data": { "inquiries": [...], "total": 15, "page": 1, "limit": 20, "totalPages": 1 } }
```

Errors: 401 | 403

Get single inquiry with diamond and business info.

Errors: 401 | 403 (owner accessing another business inquiry) | 404

Storefront initial load. Returns business info + first 50 diamonds in one call. No auth required.

Response 200:
```json
{ "success": true, "data": { "business": { "name": "...", "logoUrl": "...", "theme": {...} }, "diamonds": [...], "total": 45 } }
```

Errors: 404 - Business not found

Paginated diamond listing for storefront. No auth required.

Errors: 404 - Business not found
